decisions.reason: As a prominently launched new product line that is very close to the core practice software business, we are likely to continue backing it and explain any weaker uptake as a temporary market-adjustment issue.
Because the education institute builds on our training capabilities and strengthens customer ties around the core software, we would be inclined to retain it rather than reverse course quickly.
The remote support tool fits directly with our support offer and installed customer base, so prior investment and operational usefulness make continued commitment more likely than withdrawal.

The analytics dashboard is closely aligned with our stated direction toward digital and efficiently managed practices, which makes management likely to keep funding it despite any early-stage disappointment.
A complete practice bundle is highly consistent with our established offer and growth path, so our public commitment and strategic fit strongly favor keeping it on the market.

The listing portal is the most distant from our established business and appears less central to our announced software strategy, so it is the easiest product for management to discontinue if results have been underwhelming.
